character.description: Kneeling backward leaning empty cloth archer, bare blank head tilted skyward, two short arms, raised drawn pale bow, faded brown leather and cloth, right facing side profile

move.action: Knee dragging cycle: front folded knee reaches slightly, hips drag forward as rear knee tucks, opposite knee reaches, returns near first pose. Bow remains raised diagonally up-right and drawn throughout. Head stays tilted upward. Stationary root and consistent bow/body proportions, exactly two arms.

attack.action: Ranged attack: raised drawn bow ready, only arms force bow downward aiming right horizontally while head remains looking UP, string releases with empty bow and no detached arrow, arms lift bow back upward to recovery. Knees remain low, same head and two arms. No particles or projectile outside body.

hit.action: Short recoil: backward leaning archer with raised bow ready, torso jolts farther back and knees stay planted, arms absorb impact with bow still upward, settles near ready. Head stays looking upward, consistent limb lengths and bow size, no effects.

dead.action: Death: kneeling drawn bow ready, shoulders droop and string relaxes, arms and bow lower to ground as body falls sideways, final collapsed cloth body with bare head and bow resting touching the body in one connected silhouette. No detached pieces or arrows, no return to ready.

style: simple chunky low resolution pixel art, faded clay brown cloth and leather, bare dark blank oval head without hood, pale ash bow and nocked arrow, kneeling backward leaning side profile right, flat broad tones
